Bomb blasts kill 155 people and injure at least 500 in central Baghdad, the country's deadliest attack for two years.

Iraq: At least 155 people have been killed and around 721 injured, after two large car bomb explosions detonated in central Baghdad. The explosions are believed to have been detonated in the green zone of central Baghdad, close to several ministry buildings.
